resources.string: Disconnected shell · No account · No network · No message storage
This build validates Messenger client structure and communication provenance only. Messaging, calling, Identity sessions, key establishment, and end-to-end encryption are not active.
The client evaluates Identity, conversation authorization, GoreeCloud Data transport, and E2EE as separate prerequisites. Missing or unknown evidence fails closed.
Examples demonstrate how the client must label actual transport and verified protection. They are not live conversations or service state.

Current release qualification still requires accepted GoreeCloud Identity, Wardveil Security, Privacy Shield, Everkeep, Mesh, Manager, corrected Stable GLAZE UI re-pin, representative-device accessibility, recovery, signing, and release evidence.
